<thought>The base peak at m/z 180.0423 likely corresponds to [M+H]+. Subtracting the proton mass gives a neutral mass of ~179.03498 Da. High‑resolution matching suggests the formula C9H7O4 (exact mass 179.03444 Da), which is within ~3 ppm and consistent with the observed ~10 % M+1 intensity (≈9 C atoms). No other heteroatoms are needed.</thought>
<final_answer>C9H7O4</final_answer>
